description: This Java class defines a mock implementation of a Poll Control Cluster, used for testing or simulation purposes within a Zigbee-like device framework. It extends a base MockCluster class, adds several attributes related to poll control parameters, and provides methods to send check-in events with various parameters.
external_methods: new ComcastPollControlCheckinEvent(this, battVoltage, battUsedMilliAmpHr, temp, rssi, lqi, retries, rejoins).send()
